description: Listed building consent for external repairs to brickwork and pointing and internal repairs to plaster work and replacement of firedoors
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Door Specifications, Design & Access Statement, D17322L-1, D17322L-2, D17322-1, D17322-2, D17322-3, D17322E-1, D17322E-2, D17322E-3 Received: 10/05/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the consent, no development shall take place until detailed drawings of the new proposed internal fire doors have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
